question: Motion to Invoke Cloture: Motion to Proceed to H.R. 3633 — To provide for a system of regulation of the offer and sale of digital commodities by the Securities and Exchange Commission and the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, to amend the Federal Reserve Act to prohibit the Federal reserve banks from offering certain products or services directly to an individual, to prohibit the use of central bank digital currency for monetary policy, and for other purposes.
result: Cloture on the Motion to Proceed Rejected (49-50, 3/5 majority required)
plain_language: This was a vote to end debate on taking up a bill that would regulate digital commodities through the commodities and securities agencies and restrict a Federal Reserve digital currency offered directly to individuals. A Yea would have moved the Senate toward taking up the bill. A Nay blocked ending debate.
